test_count_note: The 15-test STB suite overlaps 13 tests in the original 41-test selection. Repeated executions are counted once.

implementation.grid: Allocation carries requested element count and TryReserveError; Error::source exposes the cause, including STB and PXF wrappers. Conversion into SimulationError preserves allocation_failed, policy limits and cancellation.
implementation.callers: Control preserves the source line. CLI uses core metadata and resource exit status. WASM and worker adapters preserve core allocation classification. Malformed sweep input keeps its established input/analysis diagnostics.
implementation.stb: Projection and workspace reservations preserve the original source and buffer object. Native tests cover projection preallocation, engine mapping, unchanged existing buffer values and later reuse.
implementation.compatibility: FrequencyGridError and StbAnalysisError no longer implement Copy; Clone/Eq remain. Allocation patterns gain source. The legacy infallible AC wrapper still uses its historical empty-result sentinel.

limitations: Failure tests use deterministic Vec capacity overflow, not real OOM or an injected system allocator failure.
STB string reservation sources are preserved in code; warning/probe allocation failures were not individually injected.
This is error-contract qualification; it establishes no new numerical accuracy, latency or whole-process memory bound.
Initial grid native and adapter checks precede the follow-up STB-buffer change. The STB suite, CLI contract, strict consumer Clippy and public optimized WASM tests execute after that change.
All C00–C14 packages remain unfinished. Control coverage stays 5/29; AcData/NoiseData control and typed-document/adapter integration remain open.
Parameter-dependent TEMP/TNOM prescanning and resolved table-row option precedence remain open, including .param ambient=27 followed by .options temp={ambient}.
Other device/model/solver allocation owners and full release qualification remain open.
